about:
American Woodwork Industry, LLC operates as a custom 3D laminate door manufacturer in Fort Pierce, Florida. The company has been in business for over ten years, serving the local area and beyond with thermofoil door and cabinet products.

The shop produces custom 3D laminate doors—often referred to as thermofoil doors—in a variety of profiles including shaker, slab, arch, and beaded styles, along with matching edge profiles and accessories. It also manufactures custom European frameless cabinets. Customers select a door style, choose a color from a catalog of woodgrain and solid finishes, and submit measurements via an emailed order form. The company describes its team as small and emphasizes quick turnaround on orders.

The product line targets both residential and commercial projects. Residential applications include kitchen cabinetry, bathroom vanities, closet systems, and entertainment centers. Commercial work covers any thermofoil need in non‑residential settings. The company does not list specific industry certifications or high‑volume production metrics, positioning itself as a local source for custom runs rather than a mass‑production supplier.

American Woodwork Industry highlights its straightforward three‑step ordering process—select style, select color, send measurements—as a key differentiator, along with a commitment to quality, fast turnaround, and responsive service. The business was founded to provide a neighborhood source for thermofoil products that previously required distant suppliers.
